name: Don't Forget Our Esports Dream
source:
Don’t Forget Our Esports Dream is a narrative game about the South Korean esports scene. Play as Bolt, a professional StarCraft: Brood War player at a flashpoint in his career. Play like a pro with guided StarCraft scenes, and see what it takes to live the dream.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/946560/Dont_Forget_Our_Esports_Dream/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《别忘了我们的电竞梦想》是一款关于韩国电竞圈的叙事游戏。扮演职业《星际争霸：母巢之战》选手博尔特，身处职业生涯的关键转折点。跟随引导体验职业级《星际争霸》比赛，了解为了实现梦想需要付出什么。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/946560/Dont_Forget_Our_Esports_Dream/]Steam[/url]]
